MIT.scope: Original AITopics source code, tests, scripts, and build configuration.
MIT.attribution: Retain the copyright and permission notice.

CC-BY-4.0.scope: Original AITopics educational content, including lessons, documentation, labs, notebooks, templates, and diagrams.
CC-BY-4.0.attribution: Credit Muhammad Nadeem Majeed and AITopics, link the licence, and indicate changes.

CC0-1.0.scope: Original synthetic datasets generated by AITopics code after provenance verification.

scopes.note: Third-party dependencies are not vendored and are not covered by this scope.
Original notebooks are CC BY 4.0 as whole files, including their code cells and original outputs. Images added later require their own provenance review.
Applies only to deterministic output of the generators listed in LICENSES/SYNTHETIC-DATA.md. Other data paths are not CC0 by default; model checkpoints and downloaded data are excluded.

These are legal texts, not original AITopics content. The CC texts are verbatim; `LICENSE` is the official MIT text with the required copyright line. Their integrity is verified by SHA-256 and the validator.

non_content_files.reason: Empty Git placeholder; it contains no copyrightable expression and no licence is asserted.

third_party_exclusions.items: NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, SciPy, joblib, matplotlib, Pillow, PyTorch, torchvision, OpenCV, Jupyter, MkDocs, Material for MkDocs, Streamlit, sentence-transformers
third_party_exclusions.terms: Their own upstream licences; installed separately.

third_party_exclusions.items: COCO, CIFAR-10, DeepFashion, TinyShakespeare, Fashion-MNIST, Speech Commands, and student-supplied datasets
third_party_exclusions.terms: Upstream dataset terms; COCO annotations are CC BY 4.0 but images remain subject to Flickr terms.

third_party_exclusions.items: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct, HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-360M-Instruct, Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, torchvision SSDLite320-MobileNetV3 COCO weights, and optional torchvision ImageNet backbones (ResNet-18 default)
third_party_exclusions.terms: Model-specific terms; check the exact model card and revision. SSDLite COCO weight terms are unresolved.
Torchvision code is BSD-3-Clause; no separate weight licence is stated and weights may inherit COCO-derived terms. Not MIT, BSD-3-Clause, or CC BY 4.0 by repository declaration.

third_party_exclusions.items: Third-party images, audio, video, and quoted excerpts
third_party_exclusions.terms: Original upstream terms or permission; attribution must be preserved.

unresolved: SSDLite COCO pretrained-weight terms are not separately stated by torchvision and remain unresolved.
External datasets, optional ASR/TTS models, and model revisions selected by students have their own upstream terms.
Whether a fine-tuned checkpoint derived from third-party weights inherits restrictions requires separate review.
No code-similarity audit was performed for external code snippets; any future adaptation must carry attribution.
